text:
Diego (CS): putting together a small 'sandbox warmup playbook' to give customers before their first live traffic. want something tiny they can run themselves + a clear ops checklist. posting draft.

Ella (Eng): nice and compact. Suggest we recommend a short seed set (10-40 prompts) representing the top user flows rather than random pings. That improves cache usefulness.

Omar (SRE): ops knobs to call out: set an alert for sustained 5xx > 2% over 3m, and p95 > 1s over 3m. On alert we: 1) reduce batch_size by half, 2) route 30% to compact fallback, 3) escalate to #release-war-room.

Diego (CS): customer-facing one-pager text (copyable):
"During onboarding we'll run a 20-45 minute warmup using a small set of representative prompts to populate your tenant cache and tune batching. We'll send a 24-hour metric snapshot and a 72-hour check-in. If we detect elevated errors we'll switch to a compact fallback model and notify you."

Tara (PM): add renewal-signal bullets: record initial p90 latency, cache hit % at 24h, error budget consumed (24h), and CS sentiment note at 72h (good/concern/action). Those feed renewal risk scoring.

Ella (Eng): lightweight starter configs to suggest to customers:
- seed_prompts: 10-40 (preferably common user examples)
- batch_size: 3 (latency) / 7 (throughput)
- concurrency: 1-3 during warmup window
- warm_pool: recommended for sustained high qps or Dedicated tenants

Diego (CS): safe prefill script (single command) for customers who want to self-serve: 
`seq 1 30 | xargs -n1 -P4 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"example prompt","max_tokens":20}'`

Omar (SRE): add observability snippets to include in kickoff email:
- success qps: `rate(http_requests_total{service="redwood",status!~"5.."}[5m])`
- cache hit rate: `sum(increase(cache_hits_total[1h])) / sum(increase(cache_lookups_total[1h]))`
- p90: `histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))`

Tara (PM): cost transparency note: estimate token cost for warmup (e.g., 30 requests of ~20 tokens @ rwd-3b) and offer customers the Dedicated warm_pool option to smooth billing. Include a short example in kickoff docs.

Ella (Eng): ops preflight checklist to add to playbook:
- confirm network/firewall + KMS access
- pin model version to avoid unintended rollouts during warmup
- validate logs and metrics flow to customer's observability destination
- run 5 smoke queries and validate responses look reasonable

Diego (CS): feedback capture to standardize: after 72h CS should fill a single-line answer in the enablement repo: "Did warmup reduce cold-start failures? (yes/no)" plus one sentence context. We'll use this signal for onboarding improvements.

cs-bot: reminder set  follow-up checklist for @Diego (CS) scheduled in 72 hours. :white_check_mark:

Diego (CS): thanks everyone. I'll sanitize and upload the one-pager to the enablement repo and add it to the kickoff email template. Tag me for edits. :pray:
